# apiname Provider

Provider for managing DomainNameAPI ("ApiName") reseller domain resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    apiname = {
      source = "abtme/apiname"
    }
  }
}

# reseller_id/api_key can also be set via the APINAME_RESELLER_ID/APINAME_API_KEY
# environment variables instead of hardcoding them here.
provider "apiname" {
  reseller_id = "your-reseller-id"
  api_key     = "your-api-key"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) DomainNameAPI API key. Can also be set via APINAME_API_KEY environment variable.
- `base_url` (String) DomainNameAPI base URL. Defaults to https://api.domainresellerapi.com/api/v1.
- `reseller_id` (String) DomainNameAPI reseller ID (UUID). Can also be set via APINAME_RESELLER_ID environment variable.
